Philadelphia Home Linked to Multiple Missing Women, Deaths

Authorities are investigating a Philadelphia home where multiple missing women have been linked, with officials stating that five are believed to be dead. Evidence, including a basement laboratory and digital data, has been discovered at the property, described as a "house of horrors." The investigation intensified as the family of one missing woman sought answers. The number of missing women connected to the residence has increased.
